name: Yanamoto Yuki
source:
A classmate who you're secretly in love with, she is a charming and graceful "heroine type" who dislikes being alone. Her shyness keeps her from opening up to others, she presents an interesting challenge to you: can you find the keys that will allow her to come out of her shell? 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140909150929/http://www.jlist.com/product/GC024]J-List[/url]]
